article.story: LAWRENCEVILLE, N.J. -- — Ty Bevins scored 17 points as Rider beat Navy 69-66 on Saturday. Bevins shot 7 for 12, including 3 for 6 from beyond the arc for the Broncs (2-5). Bryce Baker added 16 points while going 6 of 10 (4 for 7 from 3-point range) while they also had five rebounds. Khalil Farmer went 6 of 10 from the field to finish with 14 points. Jinwoo Kim finished with 19 points for the Midshipmen (4-3). David Burnett added 16 points and six rebounds for Navy. Luke Mayberry finished with 10 points. Rider went into halftime leading Navy 33-31. Baker scored eight points in the half. Rider used a 7-0 second-half run erase a five-point deficit and take the lead at 55-53 with 7:43 remaining in the half before finishing off the victory. Bevins scored 14 second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
